主要内容: SouthCorp Capital, Inc. announced on February 24, 2015, that it had entered into an agreement to produce two weight loss products for a company that will also produce and air infomercials. The company expects to begin producing the products within the next 75-90 days. This marks a strategic move into the consumer goods sector, focusing on health and wellness products. The agreement highlights the company's expansion into new markets and its focus on leveraging infomercials as a marketing channel. The move is expected to enhance the company's product portfolio and increase its market presence in the health and wellness industry.
